description: First Change Memory V3: inspect concealed carrier negatives, then continuously frame the earliest changed carriers with inertial physical lenses.
name: First Change Memory V3 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Roll the film. Inspect concealed carrier negatives to identify the first reversal. Inspection reads fully framed carriers: their motif and any recorded past reversal time. Empty inspections are safe. Inspected motifs and notebook readings stay visible; re-inspect to update old readings. The film continues moving during inspection. Centre the first carrier in lens A and bind. Keep every bound carrier wholly inside its lens together to fill the 6.5-second exposure. Lost framing erases recoverable exposure. A wrong or empty binding, incomplete certification or exhausted 75-second film ends the episode. Drag a lens to steer it, then right-click that physical lens to inspect. SPACE commits the selected lens binding. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, blank, browser-settings or non-task tabs.
